name: wiggins
caption:
TRADE COURT, CASE #1: NO. 1 PICK. BUST? 🎮🏀 Andrew Wiggins was the No. 1 overall pick. Minnesota traded him to us anyway.

• Drafted 1st overall in 2014, then dealt to Minnesota: Rookie of the Year
• Feb 2020: Minnesota sends him to us in the D'Angelo Russell trade
• 2022: his first All-Star Game
• 2022 Finals: 18.3 points, 8.8 rebounds, and stifling defense on Jayson Tatum
• Then: a ring with us

Bust, or not?

Your verdict: comment W or L 👇
Case #2 drops tomorrow night. Follow so you don't miss it.

facts.claim: Wiggins: selected first (1st, No. 1, #1) overall in the 2014 NBA draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers, then traded to Minnesota (MINN.); NBA Rookie of the Year (2015); February 6, 2020: traded with two draft picks to the Golden State Warriors for D'Angelo Russell and others, two (2) years before his 2022 All-Star selection (first, 1st); 2022 NBA champion (1 ring); in the 2022 Finals averaged 18.3 points, 8.8 rebounds and 1.5 blocks while playing stifling defense on Jayson Tatum
